english.title: Erect or use apparatus for sound/speech/images without authority - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) erected or used apparatus or a portable entertainment device for the transmission, receipt, recording, reproduction or amplification of sound, speech or images

(A)_[for commercial purposes]_
(B)_[in a security restricted area]_

at Liverpool John Lennon Airport without first obtaining the permission of Liverpool Airport Limited
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 4(8) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
